continuation_notes.architecture: WorkspaceWindow inherits AuthoringActions. PackageEditor owns shared mutable PackageSession payload, history, dirty baseline and atomic save. set_session suppresses commit signals with refreshing flag. Legacy pure methods extracted by AST into ClauseComposer and DataQueries for parity without Tk UI. LayoutPanel.details_ready signals after rebuilding dynamic property controls, ensuring controls remain editable even on initial selection. LocalJob QThread instances are tracked by WorkspaceWindow.local_jobs and close waits for completion. CommsService runs QProcess jobs with cancellation/timeouts; catalog/conversion dialogs use it. ClauseComposer adds original pure match classification helpers and safe names with spaces via CLAUSE{name}. UserSettings extends CommsSettings with original defaults JSON, unknown-key retention, validated conflict-aware saves, work_dir/shared_dir and section helpers. ConfigLockouts reads fresh files and blocks concurrent changes; write paths use SharedFolderActions.require_shared_sync matching original OneDrive behavior. Close-config picker uses shortName CLI contract but separate numeric protection ID prevents lock bypass. CommsService channel limits regular/read/resources=4, download_all/preview=1; CommandJob retries login once on unauthorized errors using the same QProcess, with per-alias serialization and hidden login stdout. Read jobs retry transient errors once after two seconds. Unix QProcess starts a new session and cancel kills its process group. ContentPanel uses request/list revisions to reject stale reads; manager disables editing during uploads, tracks HTML+metadata baseline including partial drafts, and deletes temporary upload files on every completion/cancel path. RichContentEditor uses a private WebEngine profile owned by its page, QWebChannel callbacks with generation IDs, CSP blocking untrusted content scripts/network loads, source-preserving no-edit snapshots, Comms chips, table operations and document undo/redo. Content has its own unsaved-change close guard. Comms OperationDialog now requires a JSON object when require_json is set. SharedPackages reads original occs-package-bundle/v1 manifests, semantic SHA-256 hashes, atool-shared-lock/v1 and atool-shared-baseline/v1. Lock writes retain unknown keys/token and createdAt, verify owner and exact bytes; exclusive create prevents local races. Publication stages current and history, compares baseline/shared hashes and lock bytes, swaps current with recoverable previous directory, rolls back on metadata/release failure, then prunes to five history snapshots. Local cleanup refuses symlinks/non-direct children/current copy and all active-lock referenced copies, re-reading protection before deletion. SharedPackageActions tracks workspace shared_package_dir/shared_mode; open_package restores edit/testing context from baseline plus current lock, close empties managers and sets session/editor None; raw/package/sample switching and quit call prepare_shared_exit. Shared mode label and action enable states update. PackageSession now honors original default filenames when a declared bundle has empty/missing files map. PackageResponses AST-copies original pure normalization/sorting/fuzzy helpers. PackageDownloadActions tracks query revision and active package_download_jobs; package_busy blocks session switching/closing/mapping/authoring during downloads, package_installing allows the validated completion to install its own result. Version-selection discard authorization is reused only while session identity/editor snapshot match, avoiding duplicate prompts. Probe uses OperationDialog accept_result for intentional nonzero availableVersions errors and falls back to latest on non-cancel failure. Actual manifest and AT are validated before installation; Shared/Edit rechecks actual version lock (including latest), applies shared-exit/sync guards, publishes retrievedFromComms then creates edit copy. OperationDialog now appends --json for require_json and handles intentional probe results; CommandResult.successful rejects both success:false and ok:false. Testing-mode save guard preserves source bytes. PackagePublishActions stages immutable bundle files, checks local/shared snapshots before dry run and actual write, handles SFD0375 Config recovery with a new dry run, preserves recovery copies on cancelled writes or concurrent local changes, installs successful CLI refreshes and syncs shared publishedToComms baseline. Publish context freezes authoring between requests. PackagePreviewActions runs preview in its independent channel with a user timeout plus transport grace, owns temporary chart-free input until job completion, preserves mapped file bytes and opens parsed output with configured programs. OperationDialog accepts timeout_ms to honor selected preview timeout. PackageEmailActions adds a modal EmailDialog with original environment defaults and wrapped CommunicationData handling. Dry-run verification fingerprints recipients/config, session identity and mapping revision, mapped file bytes, payload and session alias; Generate invalidates when any changes. Existing recipient arrays use the original file; missing structures are copied into owned temporary input, cleaned on every job completion. Generate hands the request to a visible operation dialog, while closing a dry-run dialog cancels its job. Layout clipboard now supports homogeneous multi-select and child kinds through transactional PackageEditor.paste_layout_items. Field hierarchy uses grouping nodes without record indices; ManagerPanel.items yields only actual records, selecting a grouping node clears details safely. ManagerControlActions restores Document toolbar controls, clears mapping without editing/history changes, updates selection-sensitive toolbar enable states, and routes Shift Model/Map behavior. Data/model/menu mapping guards now respect package_busy; package_busy handles pre-install setup safely. PackageConditionDialog is modal, checks original condition and session identity, validates with PayloadValidation before applying one editor update/undo; association-only ghosts cannot edit conditions. PackageDocumentActions Refresh flushes pending properties and rebuilds the memory model without replacing files/history. CatalogDialog adds --json and requires structured object responses; token fuzzy filtering clears hidden selections and rejects their acceptance. retry_shared_operation retries only errno.ETIMEDOUT with original (1,2,4) delays; JSON reads and idempotent copy/mkdir/publication metadata operations use it. Exclusive lock acquisition and publication rename operations retain their existing guarded protocol and are not blindly repeated. Validation regex had double-escaped character-class syntax inherited from original; corrected to recognize JSON paths near == comparisons. RichContentEditor embeds content_chip_editors.js into the trusted nonce script in content_editor.html, keeping static chip code readable. Chip dialogs draft off-document and commit only if their generation and owning chip still match. Loop marker payloads parse JSON regardless of key order and preserve marker metadata/body; source mode validates wrapper and supports unsupported transforms. Data Type choices/format presets match original. Conditions keep Text/Content drafts, scoped field chips and typed $ completion (Ctrl+Space supported), Content-list name suggestions and required validation. Condition text serializes browser block lines without artificial terminal newline. Text Comms tokenization balances nested tag kinds instead of stopping at an inner close tag, preserving encoded nested conditions/loops. Python rich context includes current Content browser names and refreshes after listing. Source reload closes stale dialogs; encoded flags survive chip edits. Cell/table property dialogs preserve other CSS/attributes and support alignment; generation guards prevent stale style writes. Dialogs scroll within short panes with sticky visible Save/Cancel and reset opening scroll.
